item.title: Correction · Chase Center: The $1.3 billion alternate cost figure was removed because its cited source gives only $1.4 billion. The Uber claims (a January 2022 move-in, a 20-year lease, about 4,000 employees, the whole office component) were replaced by The Real Deal's 2025 report that Uber and the Warriors each lease office space. The opening milestone now says Metallica and the SF Symphony played the September 6, 2019 opening and the Warriors first played there on October 5, 2019; the Valkyries milestone is described as their May 16, 2025 debut as scheduled per the SF Chronicle; and the Blocks 29-30 and 'no construction as of February 2025' wording for the neighboring hotel proposal was removed. 'Thrive City' is now cited to Chase Center's own site. Thrive City tenants that rested on pre-opening announcements (Dumpling Time, Gott's, Fikscue, Cupcakin', Siren) now carry month-level or blank opening dates; addresses that no source gave were removed or cited to DataSF business registrations; open status for nine tenants is now cited to Chase Center's live Thrive City page. Siren, a time-limited pop-up, is now shown closed, and b8ta's dates were blanked. The Sarap Shop is shown as an in-arena concession, and the interior photo is now labelled as a photo from completion.

item.title: Added · Chase Center: SF Standard (Oct 13, 2022) reported that Cupcakin' Bake Shop, right next to the Warriors team store, would frost its first batch of red velvets the following Tuesday, Oct 18, 2022, as its fifth Bay Area location (after two in Berkeley, one in Oakland and one in Walnut Creek). Chase Center's Jan 31, 2023 release lists Cupcakin' Bake Shop among Thrive City retailers in operation. The SF Standard article gives no street address.

item.title: Added · Chase Center: SFist (Jan 31, 2020) reported that Dumpling Time was getting set to debut its third San Francisco location at Chase Center on Monday, Feb 3, 2020, and called it the first restaurant to open in the still-developing Thrive City; an Instagram post embedded in the article, dated Jan 31, says it was already 'officially open'. The article gives no street address, so the exact opening day is uncertain.

Wikipedia does not mention Thrive City, and no readable source gives the opening or closing date of the Thrive City store, so only the chain's closure is stated here.

item.title: Added · Chase Center: Harmonic Brewing opened a taproom with a 2,000 sq ft waterfront patio in Thrive City in May 2021; the SF Chronicle's hours box lists opening on May 10-11, with regular hours to begin the following week. The Chronicle gives the address as 1 Warriors Way, contrasts the taproom with Harmonic's original Dogpatch location, and does not count locations. Suite 206 at 7 Warriors Way is the address in Harmonic's DataSF business registration.

item.title: Milestone · Chase Center: SF Board of Supervisors approves a separate, Warriors-proposed hotel/condo/retail complex (129-room hotel, 21 condos, ~25,000 sf retail) next to Chase Center at the northeast corner of the arena (Bisnow, July 2020); the article says the Warriors had not said when they hope to start construction, and no later status was found. Its relationship to this parcel (8722025) is not confirmed -- see open questions. Not treated as this record's own status: Chase Center itself opened in 2019 and remains complete regardless of this separate, unconfirmed proposal. (~2020)
